name: @loom/plugin-durable-state
description: Typed, versioned, migratable keyed state for Loom (ADR 0051 D2) — carry state across bounded runs as RECORDED effects: load/save results land in STEP_COMPLETED so replay folds the recorded value and never re-reads the store. Zod-validated envelopes, registered version-to-version migrations (loud StateContractMismatch when absent), compare-and-set revisions, and a sentinelState convenience for schedule-driven agents.
